description: This file defines a controller class for managing subscription statuses within the admin interface of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting subscription status records, along with handling related views and user permissions.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Controller class to manage subscription statuses, including listing, editing, saving, and deleting statuses, with appropriate permissions and interface rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the main subscription status list page by setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList and outputs the list of subscription statuses for AJAX or direct access.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of subscription statuses, including pagination, sorting, and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a subscription status, including language data and existing descriptions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the form submission to create or update a subscription status, including validation, permission checks, and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription statuses, ensuring permissions and checking for default or associated records.
